call_points.text: Management explicitly declined to give revenue growth guidance for FY27.
Raw material cost push of 5-6% on imported synthetics, offset by matching price increases.
Cost push impact not seen this quarter due to 140-150 days of inventory; visible from the current quarter.
Gross margin rose 130 bps; channel mix cost about 100 bps, so same-mix uplift was 230 bps.
Franchise potential trade areas in excess of about 600 remain to be filled.
Franchise partners earn about 18-24% ROI, cited as the floor for a successful partner.
Competitive intensity at lower price points: management said it is too early to comment and is watching closely.
NorthStar was a drag on sneakers, with lines being rationalised consciously over the next couple of quarters.
No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management declined to give a forward-looking number for e-commerce growth.
Franchise network has crossed 700 stores; management wants to approach 1,000 stores in the next 12 months.
Second consecutive quarter of 5%+ value growth, volume-led and broad-based across channels and categories.
call_points.versus_prior: Q4FY26 revenue grew 5% YoY on volumes

call_points.text: Hush Puppies is the fastest-growing brand and contributes 18-20% of turnover; store expansion will be disproportionate.
Blended raw material inflation is 5-6%; no price hike rolled out yet and near-term impact is seen as neutral.
Trade receivables rose 65% YoY on channel mix; management says days outstanding and doubtful-debt provisions show no deterioration.

operating_notes.text: Bata India paid ₹55.50 lakh in full and final settlement for a 2010 workman dispute, closing the litigation.
Q4FY26 one-time items: VRS cost ₹28.1 Cr and non-cash forex loss ₹22.4 Cr on the royalty liability.
Zero-based merchandising extended to about 550 stores, contributing over 70% of store sales; e-commerce grew in the mid-twenties.
Gross inventory reduced 13% in Q4FY26; advertising spend rose 1.5x.
ZBM at 700 stores as of end-May 2026 contributes 70% of COCO turnover; at 550 stores it was 50-55%.
E-commerce is 12-13% of business, B2C about 5-6% of that, and bata.com about 14% of B2C; bata.com grew 81% YoY.
Hush Puppies contributes 18-20% of turnover and is the fastest-growing brand; sub-₹1,000 products are 35-40% of turnover.
Inventory turns at about 2.5 plus, edging towards 2.7, with availability at its highest levels.
Full-price sales close to 90%, with a continuous uptick over the last 4 or 5 quarters.
Franchise like-for-like growth close to high single digits for the last 4 quarters.

timeline.summary: BATA (BN) B.V. confirmed no encumbrance on Bata India shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026, signed by Director_A K.J. Santegoeds on April 2.
Bata India settled a 2010 industrial dispute with workmen for an aggregate amount of ₹55.50 lakh, resulting in the case's dismissal.
Bata India Limited’s remote e-voting for Postal Ballot concluded on May 23, 2026, per AVP & Compliance Officer Nitin Bagaria.
Shareholders approved Ms. Radha Rajappa’s (DIN: 08530439) re-appointment as Independent Director via remote e-voting on May 23, 2026, with 99.48% support.
Bata India Limited schedules Post Earnings Call for June 3, 2026, at 4:30 PM IST with Managing Director & CEO Gunjan Shah, CFO Amit Aggarwal, and AVP Nitin Bagaria.
Bata India Limited declared audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26 ended March 31, 2026, with auditor reports, dividend, AGM date, and record date.
Bata India reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹827.6 Cr, up 5% YoY on volumes, with ₹50.5 Cr of VRS and forex one-offs and a recommended ₹9 per share dividend.

Bata India Limited’s Board, led by Nitin Bagaria (AVP – Company Secretary & Compliance Officer), recommended a dividend of ₹9 per equity share (180%) for FY2026, pending AGM approval on August 12, 2026.

Bata India's June 3, 2026 Q4FY26 call transcript: management put like-for-like PBT growth at about 11% and cash from operations up about 18%, with ZBM at 700 stores and raw material inflation at 5-6%.
On its 13 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Bata India said revenue grew 4% to ₹979 Cr with volume and price split evenly, and that it had crossed 2,000 EBO stores.
Post Earnings Call scheduled for Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 4:00 P.M. IST.
